evidence.quote: I am concerned that new capital requirements could unnecessarily hinder bank lending and diminish competition.
As I and many of my colleagues have noted, the banking system today is strong and resilient, despite recent banking stress.
Failure to follow this approach could have significant consequences for banks navigating higher interest rates while meeting the credit and financial needs of their customers.
